item.title: Debate Intensifies Over Proposed “Data Center Development Act” in South Carolina
item.description: South Carolina lawmakers are weighing a new legislative proposal designed to regulate the rapid expansion of data centers across the state. The “Data Center Development Act” seeks to balance the state’s burgeoning digital economy with the protection of public resources and utility rates. Data centers are specialized industrial facilities housing massive arrays of computer servers. […]
